actions: After the orchestrator merges this story branch to main, cut the hub release from a fresh clean clone of main: `mise run release -- 1.2.49`. The `## v1.2.49` section of docs/hub-releases.md is already written.
Run `mise run hosts:install` from a clean checkout at tag v1.2.49 on big-chungus and on the Mac. Then check that both hosts' `current` is v1.2.49 and that the catch-up candybars still fire.
